data.action: 独自侧卧在深色丝绸床榻上，黑色暗纹长袖衬衫微敞，狼耳与尾巴轻搭床面，琥珀双眸在柔和烛火下卸去防备凝视近处
data.camera: cowboy shot, lying on side, eye level, intimate warm lighting
data.description: 静谧的私人卧室内，德克萨斯侧卧在微凉的深色真丝床褥间。宽松的黑色暗纹男友风衬衫自然滑落半边香肩，露出冷白精致的锁骨。尖耸的狼耳与毛茸茸的尾巴随平稳呼吸轻缓微颤，琥珀色的眼眸在床头摇曳烛光中褪去白日的清冷与警惕，带着只为眼前人流露的深切柔情。
data.lighting: 床头摇曳烛光与柔和暗金泛光
data.location: 罗德岛私人典雅卧室大床
data.promptProse: Texas relaxes on her side atop dark silk bedsheets in a quiet bedroom, her oversized black pinstripe shirt unbuttoned and slipping off one bare shoulder while her wolf ears and tail rest calmly against the bedding. Flickering bedside candlelight softens her subtle blush and warm amber gaze directed at the viewer.
data.title: 德克萨斯 · 烛火罗帐中的孤狼柔情
data.animaCaption: She lies gently on her side on dark silk sheets with her black shirt slipping off one shoulder.
